headline: DeVry earns workplace culture award; no material vendor or expansion signals

signals.summary: DeVry University earned 2026 Top Workplaces Industry Award for Education and eight Culture Excellence Awards, indicating positive organizational momentum and employer brand strength.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor for case-study or advocacy opportunity if organization expands digital/communications programs, but award alone does not trigger urgent motion at education segment.

headline: DeVry University expanding program offerings and strengthening employer brand through new partnerships and remote-work recognition

signals.summary: DeVry partnered with Pulse Radiology Institute to launch a new MRI technologist degree program, addressing a national skills shortage. This represents meaningful curriculum expansion and signals growth in enrollment and campus/online program footprint.
signals.suggestedAction: Outreach to DeVry's marketing and communications team: the new MRI program will require HIPAA-compliant marketing campaigns to recruit students and partner with healthcare facilities. Offer a Paubox Marketing trial to ensure all recruitment communications (email, forms) meet HIPAA standards.

signals.summary: DeVry recognized as 2026 Top Workplace for Remote Work, and ranked No. 3 nationally for Information Technology programs. Positive institutional brand signals may open doors for case-study and advocacy opportunities.
signals.suggestedAction: Add DeVry to advocacy/case-study pipeline: reach out to the VP of Communications or Chief Marketing Officer to explore a co-authored thought leadership piece on how HIPAA-compliant email enables secure collaboration in remote-first education and healthcare partnerships.
